## Scope and source notes

George, Business24, email and MultiCash support XML statements. Direct v02 XML and v08 archive member validate unchanged against repository ISO XSDs. V02 RAR is documentation-only; v08 RAR includes a bank XML sample. Archive references remain separate from reproducible raw-source inventory pending RAR support. No open redistribution license established; originals should remain external-only.

No open redistribution licence established. Consult the publisher before republishing originals.
